bioconda.name: plasticdb
bioconda.summary: Python client and CLI for the PlasticDB API: plastic-degrading microorganisms, proteins and the evidence behind them.
bioconda.description:
plasticdb is a typed Python client (and the `plasticdb` command-line tool)
for PlasticDB (https://v2.plasticdb.org), a curated database of
plastic-degrading microorganisms and enzymes. Optional extras (pandas,
polars, biopython) are not installed by this package.
